# fall-kit

> Fall Kit v3.1.1: one script that gives any web page an AI helper the person controls (off, WebLLM in the browser, or their own key straight to the provider; keys held in the tab), with recycling of the opening, and the home of the Lego socket (kard.v1) every estate build carries. MIT.

## Canonical URL

https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fall-kit/

## The shared foundation (core/)

https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fall-kit/core/ — the modules every estate node runs: a LIGHT packet door that verifies before it decodes (vendor/light), antibodies on the LIGHT wire shared by negative selection (antibody.mjs, vendor/immune), identity as a capability with a budget it cannot cross (identity.mjs, vendor/wallet), geometric memory kept as a LIGHT vault (vendor/memory), a signed contribution ledger counting only re-checkable work (vendor/ledger), and evidence-weighted couplings (node.mjs). break-it and konomi-slm run on it as nodes. Nine claims sealed first (core/claims.json); the receipt (core/receipts/foundation.json) re-runs byte for byte in CI.

## Files

- fall-kit.js: the kit (FallKit global): aiComplete, aiChat, askPage, pageOpening, aiImage, aiVideo, aiTTS, aiSTT, lastUsage, forgetKeys, requestOf, textOf, usageOf, init, openSettings, meshStart, meshPost, helpSection
- socket.mjs: the five studs (brain, manifest, mesh, memory, proof); studsOf, present, kardOf, checkKard, kardText
- kard-writer.mjs: writes a build's kard.json from its files; --check for CI (with no --name, re-measures against the existing kard.json)
- socket-watch.mjs: clones all 100 builds and re-measures each against its kard.json (daily workflow)
- socket-snapshot.mjs → socket-kards.json: a dated record of the 100 (kard, served commit, its GitHub runs and verdictOf them, live status); Kardlings vendors it for its gear cards
- recycle.mjs: talkCost and teamCost at published rates (default Claude Opus 5.5)
- socket-builds.json: the 100 builds that carry the socket (branch/page where a site is not served from the default branch's root)
- porter.mjs: inlines the kit into a build before its own </head> (markup.mjs: never inside a script); shim.js: one-line loader
- kard.json: this repo's own kard
